name: Tidewater Studio Commissions Agent
description: Takes commission enquiries for Tidewater Studio, a ceramics studio of nine makers: dinner services, restaurant tableware and architectural tiles. It quotes lead times and asks the questions a quote needs; prices are confirmed by a person.

skills.name: Commission enquiry
skills.description: Collects what a commission needs (pieces, quantities, glaze, deadline, delivery address region) and returns the studio's current lead time and the next step. Never takes payment.
examples: We need 120 plates and 120 bowls for a restaurant opening in May.
Could you make a dinner service for twelve in a sea-green glaze?

skills.name: Lead times
skills.description: Gives the studio's current lead time for tableware and for tiles, in weeks.
examples: How long is your wait for tiles at the moment?
